author: L3G1TN00BZ
body:
Name: L3G1TN00BZ
Reason for ban: Advertising other server
Why i should be unbaned:
i was banned by DoctaPop on April 6, 2015 at 1:26 PM for advertising without a warning i knew this was a rule but it was for a good reason me and my friend were playing CTM-CTW and we thought we could build a map for the server so i made a server but needed more people to help build so i said come to my server and gave them my ip but i didnt say that we were building for the server. so i can see where DoctaPop could see that it was advertising or stealing all of your guys players but i do wish to be unbanned. this is a first offence too. it has been almost 24 hours since ive been banned this is a great server and ive made it my daily routine to play it. :)
Sorry for advertising :'(
Please unban me this cant be permanent
